source.map: City of Portland Johnson Creek Basin plan district (PCC 33.537, Map 537-1) and its subdistricts, as Portland Maps publishes them; flood and trail layers as listed in inputs
source.says: The Springwater corridor buffer (33.537.130), South subdistrict land-class density (33.537.140.E) and the Flood Risk Area (33.537.160) reach these sites; the screen measures none of them

inputs.taxlots: quadfit s2_lots (data/quadfit_2026-10-30_dd_c6, Metro RLIS taxlots), the lot shapes the screen asks
inputs.subdistricts: plan-subdistricts.geojson, PLDIST JC SUBDIST SOUTH and FLOOD RISK (BPS_Zoning_Code_Layers layer 1, fetched 2026-10-22)
inputs.retrace_taxlots: quadfit s2_lots (data/quadfit s2_lots.parquet of 2026-07-24, Metro RLIS taxlots), used only to take lots out

source.method: The South subdistrict outline and every lot (10% or more inside the plan district) with at least 1 sq ft inside it, plus the Flood Risk Area subdistrict and every lot touching it (1 sq ft or more), plus every lot within 100 ft of the Springwater Corridor Trail centreline or within 2 ft of a taxlot the trail runs through; traced and closed as johnson-creek-impervious-lots. Re-traced 2026-11-08 (FOLLOWUPS 140; ruling 2026-11-01-trees-ignored-entered-per-lot) from the 2026-11-01 tracing by taking out the lots only 33.537.125 reached -- in the combined flood hazard area or near the corridor, but touching neither subdistrict nor the corridor reach: 993 of the 6,317 lots held before, 25 of them still partly covered by an overlapping kept taxlot and so still held. South subdistrict lots in the combined flood hazard area stay held although 33.537.020 sends them to 33.537.150 instead of 140.E (not separated; the conservative answer). Checked: no lot held 90% or more before falls below 90%, and no lot not held before is held now.
source.traced_by: FOLLOWUPS 109 Portland plan districts part 1, 2026-11-01; re-traced FOLLOWUPS 140, 2026-11-08
